stem:
Omar has eight odd-numbered cards. He wants to place all eight cards so that their sum is exactly $55$.

What can he decide before trying any cases?

options.text: Name the task a possible selection, and stop checking parity.
Parity does not apply until he first chooses which cards make the total.
The sum of eight odd numbers is even, so it cannot equal $55$.
Any eight positive cards can make $55$ if their sizes are small enough.

teacher.key_rationale: An even count of odd addends yields an even sum, so eight odd cards cannot total the odd number 55. A renames the task. B postpones the parity test. D treats size estimates as enough.
